bullets.text: Halvern Dam on the Sorrel River above Brindlemark in the Assek Valley was reported damaged on 9 September 2025, prompting a dam safety emergency.
Damage to the dam and its right abutment led authorities to raise the alert level from Yellow to Orange and order a mandatory evacuation of Brindlemark and Ferris Hollow the following morning.
Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark, with further residents moved out of Ferris Hollow; no casualties were reported in this window.
Sorrel Basin Water Authority and the operator issued information on the dam's condition while the evacuation was under way, with the cause of the damage not yet stated.
Reports emerge that Halvern Dam and its right abutment are damaged.
Sorrel Basin Water Authority provides information on the dam; the operator follows with its own statement.
The alert level is raised from Yellow to Orange and a mandatory evacuation is ordered for Brindlemark and Ferris Hollow.
Roughly 11,800 residents are evacuated from Brindlemark and people are moved out of Ferris Hollow.
Halvern Dam and its right abutment were damaged.
A mandatory evacuation was ordered for Brindlemark after the dam damage was reported.
The mandatory evacuation order also covered Ferris Hollow, from which residents were moved out.
Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark.
The alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange as the evacuation was ordered.
Sorrel Basin Water Authority issued information on the condition of Halvern Dam.
The operator provided information on the dam later the same evening.
